text: Carrier objection to the importance ruling: bare MassRatio cannot encode both wsum (the value denominator) and Coverage(observed importance leaves / eligible leaves). If conditioningMass=wsum, the ruled few-heavy versus many-light discriminator is lost; if conditioningMass=observed leaf count, MassRatio divides the numerator by the wrong quantity. Required shape is MassRatio plus Coverage or a new carrier with value, weightSum, and Coverage. Do not implement the bare-MassRatio sentence until the chief amends it.
